title: Assistant Manager - CRM
jobDescription:
Key Responsibilities -

  1. Understand the product funnels and work with tech and product teams to define the events for marketing automation tools to enable campaign set up.

  2. Evaluating the business and campaign objectives to plan configuration (segmentation, profiling, audience cohorts, content, frequency, channels) of effective customer lifecycle campaigns to deliver incremental growth as per the objective and set KPIs.

  3. Support for seamless set up, campaign QA and execution for CLM campaigns.

  4. Planning for experiments in new and existing CLM campaigns to drive higher efficiencies for achieving set objectives and KPIs

  5. Optimization of targeting and communication for existing customer segments, data analysis using transactional and intent signals to propose new customer segments for better targeting

  6. Reporting, Analysis and insight mining of the reports of CLM campaigns, maintaining benchmarks and creation of consumable reports / dashboard to deliver actionable inputs for improvements of the campaigns.

  7. Internal and external stakeholder management, to work with agencies, channel partner and vendors to drive red Bus business objectives.

You will be directly driving -

● Campaign Planning & Execution: Responsible for the end-to-end planning, setup, and flawless execution of CLM and retention marketing campaigns on marketing automation platforms.

● Performance Monitoring & Reporting: Oversee day-to-day campaign reporting, track key health metrics, and build dashboards to share insights with the team. You will be the first point of contact for translating raw data into key marketing decisions.

● Impact & Incrementality: Conduct ongoing impact and incrementality analysis for new and existing campaigns. Use data to measure effectiveness, provide insights for optimization, and advocate for a data-led approach to campaign strategy.

● Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with creative, content, and tech teams to gather requirements, close dependencies, and ensure all components for campaign launch are delivered on time.

title: Assistant Manager - Analytics
jobDescription:
● Campaign Measurement & Budget Optimization: Track, analyze, and report on the performance of various marketing channels (Performance Marketing, Brand Campaigns, SEO, and other digital channels). Drive data-backed recommendations to optimize marketing budget allocation, lower CAC, and maximize ROI.

● Product & Funnel Analytics: Deep dive into traffic patterns, user funnels, and conversion rates across the red Bus app and website to identify drop-offs, user friction

points, and growth opportunities.

● Events Instrumentation: Partner closely with product and engineering teams to ensure clean data collection by defining, tracking, and auditing custom user events (e.g., clicks, searches, bookings).

● User Segmentation: Build data-driven user personas and behavioral segments to power high-impact, targeted CRM campaigns and personalized marketing initiatives.

● Dashboarding & Reporting: Design, build, and maintain automated, intuitive

dashboards to monitor key marketing metrics (KPIs) and regularly present actionable findings to marketing leadership.

● Advanced Project Support: Assist the team in forward-looking projects involving

Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) and Causal Inference ML models to understand true marketing incrementality.

● Market Research: Conduct market and competitive research to identify emerging trends, benchmarks, and new growth avenues.

#LI-DNI

title: Senior Sales Executive
jobDescription:
Key RESPONSIBILITIES:
Strategic Planning
  • Act as an ambassador and representative to promote positive relationships and strong partnerships for the benefit of the organization
  • Drives the development of strategic business and financial plans, in alignment with overall corporate goals
  • Takes lead in implementation of company programs, procedures, methods and practices across the organization

Operational Efficiencies
  • Achievement of overall sales of the region (Including Travel Agent Partners & Distributors) and monitoring performance (Individual & Overall) on daily basis.
  • Implementation, feedback and co-ordination on various promotional & Incentive programs launched by product team
  • Ensure credit control and adherence of KYC norms as per company policy
  • Assist in implementation of Promotions and below the line activities in conjunction with the Business Head for new acquisition of customers across segments.
  • Identify and develop new markets (Tier 2/3 cities) in the region to drive the business targets of the region
  • Work closely with the inventory team to activate bus operators as agents / maintain price parity both online and offline and bring in the best pricing and commission to the B2B channel
  • Develop a good mix of retail agent base for bus and bus hire bookings.
  • Co-ordinate and follow up with all cross functional teams.
  • Strengthen relationship with existing / new business partners & other relevant stakeholders.

Continuous Improvement
  • Develop innovative initiatives to enhance internal efficiencies and effectiveness
  • Maintains awareness of new and emerging trends in the B2B segment

Educational Qualification: MBA

Exp Minimum and Maximum: 1-4 Years

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

  • Strong communication and negotiation skills
  • Ability to understand complex products and explain in simple language to user basis situation
  • Customer centric and able to manage multiple priorities
  • Pleasant action-oriented personality with career orientation
  • Good command over Local language and English.

title: Senior Business Development Manager
jobDescription:
Strategic Planning

● Identify and develop new market opportunities, makes recommendations based on emerging trends, opportunities and threats

● Own the supply plan for the designated region in order to meet the business plan and goals.

● Responsible for both strategic and tactical initiatives related to revenue maximization, market share improvement

● Manages and maintains Group and Transient inventories, updated knowledge on industry trends and periodic market researches.

● Should be up to date with the market knowledge of intercity bus travel and ensure that all opportunities to grow rebus’s market share are tapped.

● Engage Bus operators and increase participation on red Bus marketplace by effectively promoting all seller side products / platforms.

● Ensure all issues pertaining to bus operators are resolved ethically and amicably

● Address and resolve all escalated customer issues and continuously work towards improving NPS for the region.

Educational Qualification: MBA

Years of Experience (Minimum & Maximum): 3 to 5 years of experience

Key skills required for the ROLE:

  • Good Key account management and negotiation skills.

  • Very strong people management

  • Interested / willing to travel extensively in the assigned State / Territory

  • Effective communication skills and

  • Ability to work with cross functional teams

title: Assistant Manager - SEO
jobDescription:
AI SEO / AEO Assistant Manager — India

Roles and Responsibilities

AEO Strategy & Execution

• Develop and execute red Bus's AEO strategy aligned with AOP, quarterly goals, and monthly objectives, with clear KPIs around AI answer visibility, brand mention share, and citation rates.

• Build and maintain an AEO performance dashboard tracking red Bus's visibility across Chat GPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and other answer engines.

• Monitor AEO positioning across key travel, OTA, and bus/train booking platforms, tracking how leading domestic and global players are referenced in AI-generated responses.

• Define and track red Bus's “Agentic Readiness Score,” measuring how well red Bus's website, docs, and content are structured for AI agent consumption.

Content Optimization for AI

• Audit and optimize red Bus's existing content (website, blog, docs, learn pages) for AI retrieval, ensuring structured data, clear entity relationships, and answer-ready formatting.

• Develop content strategies specifically designed to win AI citations, including comparison pages, FAQ schemas, definitive guides, and structured product narratives.

• Collaborate with the content team to create authoritative, entity-rich content that positions red Bus as the primary source for travel, bus and train booking, and route-related topics in LLM training and retrieval.

• Implement and maintain schema markup, structured data, and semantic HTML optimizations that improve AI comprehension of red Bus's content.

• Develop guidelines for RAG-optimized content architecture — defining how pages should be structured (header hierarchies, summary blocks, definition-first writing, explicit claim statements) so that retrieval systems consistently surface the most relevant red Bus passage for a given query, rather than a competitor's.

Technical AEO & Website Readiness

• Work with engineering to ensure red Bus's website architecture supports AI crawlers, agents, and retrieval systems, including proper robots.txt directives, API endpoints for agentic access, and clean information architecture.

• Conduct regular technical audits focused on AI readiness, crawlability by AI bots, structured data integrity, content freshness signals, and page experience metrics.

• Optimize site speed, mobile experience, and Core Web Vitals as baseline requirements for both traditional SEO and AI answer eligibility.

• Monitor and resolve technical issues impacting AI visibility, including indexing gaps, stale content, and broken structured data.

• Own red Bus's agentic AI readiness, ensuring all key surfaces (website, developer docs, pricing/fare pages, product pages, integration guides) are structured for autonomous AI agents to navigate, extract information, and take action without human intervention.

• Drive agentic AI booking readiness, working with Product and Engineering to ensure red Bus's search, booking, and checkout flows are parseable and completable by AI agents acting on behalf of travellers, including structured form data, clear step sequencing, and machine-readable eligibility criteria. (Extend to operator onboarding flows where relevant.)

• Define and maintain agentic interface standards, including machine-readable sitemaps, API-accessible content layers, agent-friendly navigation patterns, and llms.txt or equivalent protocols that enable AI agents to understand and interact with red Bus's digital ecosystem.

AEO Tool Stack & Measurement

• Evaluate, implement, and manage the AEO tool stack (e.g., Otterly.ai, Profound, Peec AI, and emerging platforms) for tracking AI answer visibility and brand mentions.

• Build measurement frameworks that quantify AEO impact on pipeline, traffic, and brand perception, establishing AEO as a reportable marketing channel.

• Design and run experiments to test content formats, structural changes, and optimization tactics that improve AI answer outcomes.

• Stay ahead of LLM ranking factors, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns, and AI search algorithm updates, translating them into actionable playbooks.

• Own red Bus's GA4 implementation as it relates to AEO and organic performance, including custom event tracking, conversion path analysis, channel grouping configurations, and funnel attribution — to accurately measure how AI-referred and organic traffic behaves across red Bus's product pages, docs, and booking flows.

• Build GA4-based reporting layers that connect AEO visibility metrics (AI citations, answer impressions) to downstream business outcomes (sessions, booking initiations, product page depth), enabling leadership to see AEO's contribution to pipeline, not just traffic.

AI-Powered Automation & Workflows

• Design and build automated SEO/AEO dashboards that pull data from multiple sources (Google Search Console, Ahrefs, AEO tracking tools, GA4) into unified, real-time views, eliminating manual reporting overhead.

• Build AI-driven content generation workflows — automated brief creation, first-draft generation, meta tag optimization, and bulk content updates powered by LLMs with human-in-the-loop quality gates.

• Create automated recommendation engines that surface SEO/AEO optimization opportunities, flagging underperforming pages, suggesting content gaps, recommending internal linking improvements, and prioritizing fixes by impact.

• Build end-to-end workflow automations using AI tools, APIs, and platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make.com, n8n, Claude API, custom scripts) to streamline repetitive SEO/AEO operations across content, technical, and reporting functions.

• Automate content refresh and decay detection workflows, identifying stale content, triggering update cycles, and auto-generating refresh briefs based on search trend shifts and AI answer changes.

• Create self-serve automation templates that enable the broader marketing team to run SEO/AEO tasks (keyword research, content audits, performance pulls) without manual intervention.

• Continuously identify automation opportunities across the SEO/AEO function, with a target of reducing manual effort by 50%+ within the first year through intelligent automation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Collaborate with SEO, Performance Marketing, Brand, and Product Marketing teams to ensure AEO strategy is integrated with broader marketing efforts.

• Work with Product and Engineering teams on developer documentation optimization, a critical surface for AI-driven recommendations in the travel booking space.

• Manage relationships with external SEO/AEO vendors, consultants, and platform providers.

• Present AEO performance reports, insights, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership, including CPO and CMO.

Qualifications

Must Have

• 5 to 7 years of experience in SEO, with at least 1–2 years of direct exposure to AEO, AI search optimization, or LLM-related content strategy.

• Deep understanding of how LLMs (GPT, Gemini, Claude, Llama) retrieve, rank, and cite web content, including RAG systems, knowledge graphs, and entity recognition.

• Hands-on experience building automation workflows and AI agents using AI tools, APIs, and platforms (Zapier, Make.com, n8n, Python scripting, or similar) — not just using tools, but architecting end-to-end automated pipelines.

• Deep hands-on experience with GA4, custom dimensions, event schema design, funnel exploration, attribution modelling, and Looker Studio or Big Query integration for advanced reporting. Ability to go beyond out-of-the-box reports and build measurement frameworks that accurately reflect the non-linear, multi-touch journeys typical of travel and e-commerce discovery.

• Proven ability to build dashboards and automated reporting systems, pulling data from multiple sources into unified views using tools like Looker Studio, Tableau, Google Sheets with APIs, or custom solutions.

• Strong technical SEO foundation — site architecture, Java Script for SEO/AEO, crawl optimization, and mobile-first indexing.

• Experience with AI-powered content generation and SEO workflows, using AI agents for automated brief creation, content drafting, meta tag generation, or bulk optimization at scale.

• Hands-on experience with SEO tools (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console) and emerging AEO tools (Otterly.ai, Profound, or similar).

• Strong communication skills with the ability to present to senior leadership and influence cross-functional stakeholders.

• Experience in e-commerce and large-scale websites is strongly preferred.

Good to Have

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. Given the role's hands-on requirements around automation pipelines, API integrations, and RAG-layer content architecture, a foundational technical education accelerates ramp-up significantly.

• Experience with content strategy for developer audiences (API docs, technical guides, integration tutorials).

• Familiarity with AI/ML fundamentals — understanding of embeddings, vector search, and how AI models process content.

• Proficiency in Python or Java Script for custom automation scripts, API integrations, and data pipelines.

• Experience with Claude API, Open AI API, or similar LLM APIs for building production-grade content and recommendation workflows.

• Experience managing external agencies or vendors in an SEO/content capacity.

• People management experience — ability to lead and mentor a small team as the AEO function scales.

• Track record of experimentation — designing A/B tests, content experiments, and iterating based on data.

• Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), AI agents, or agentic workflow frameworks.
